newsitem.title: USA: Golden Books stake cut by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Golden Books stake cut by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Wednesday it cut its stake in Golden Books Family Entertainment Inc to 4,053,799 common shares or 15.65 percent from 17.91 percent previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 216,900 common shares sold between January 15 and January 27 at prices ranging from $10.75 to $11.3017 per share.
Golden Books, headquartered in New York, is the largest publisher of children's books in the North American retail market.
